object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Use the list_tools result from the MELLON-MCP-SRS-34 test. Expected: each offered tool is a row of exactly one of the three tables, each parameter in a tool's inputSchema is a row under that tool, and nothing else is offered. On 2026-11-11, 46 tools were offered and none was missing from a table. test_read_only_refuses_every_write_tool only checks that 17 names are offered.
